data.name: Ravinder
data.gender_notes: Ravinder is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ravinder is a compound name derived from the Sanskrit words 'Ravi' meaning sun and 'Indra' meaning lord or ruler. The name signifies a brave and powerful ruler, a king who is a master of his domain. The name Ravinder carries the meaning “Brave, Powerful Ruler” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Punjabi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Ravinder usually hope their child will grow to embody brave, powerful ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who embody the qualities of the sun god Ravi and the rain god Indra. It represents power, courage, and the ability to rule over one's own life and the lives of others.
data.etymology: Ravinder belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Brave, Powerful Ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ravinder total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
